name: Dodecamethylcyclohexasiloxane
description: Dodecamethylcyclohexasiloxane (CAS 540-97-6 ), commercially recognized as Cyclomethicone 6, is a cyclic silicone fluid used across personal care, coatings, and industrial applications. It functions as a low-viscosity carrier and surface-conditioning agent. This chemical delivers essential lubricity and slip to finished formulations. In personal care manufacturing, it acts as a volatile carrier for active ingredients and conditioning agents in skin creams, hair serums, and antiperspirants. The fluid is designed to evaporate cleanly without leaving a residue. Coatings and release agent formulators incorporate it to improve surface wetting and reduce friction on substrates where silicone-based lubrication is required. Automotive and industrial lubricant producers use it as a base fluid or diluent in specialty greases and mold-release compounds. It provides consistent performance in high-friction environments and specialized mechanical applications. Adhesive and sealant manufacturers blend it into silicone elastomer systems to control viscosity during processing. This helps improve the final surface finish on cured products and ensures easier application for industrial users. The product is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid in drum and IBC quantities. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet various manufacturing needs and regulatory standards. The cosmetic-grade material meets purity requirements for personal care end-use. Buyers should confirm cyclic siloxane content and D6 purity levels against their formulation or regulatory requirements before sourcing.
